code: code/ holds the agent, tools, client, experiment, tasks and handbook, kept as they were when the run finished; long lines in tools.py were later re-wrapped. The sha256 hashes below identify these archived files as they are now. That they are the code that ran, and that the model and environment did not change, rests on my own record. Replaying the 147 recorded tool calls through the archived tools reproduces all 147 observations: that shows the tools behave as recorded on those calls, not that the files are byte-identical to what ran.
